_about: Every technology of the thesis (thesis.md section 3). status: 'model' = runs today (elements/<id>); 'planned' = not built. carriers: the flows the block takes (in) or gives (out). The links between blocks, used by the interface and checked by system/setup.py: fixed = always in the system; needs = every block listed must be in the system too; needs_one_of = at least one of them (the heat sources of a heat storage); follows = in the system exactly when one of these is (the gas supply follows the blocks that burn gas).
